authority: The game owner confirmed that a patient's one lifetime panel attempt remains spent even when the reality in which it was used is discarded at Blackhole Sync.

rules/overlays/hospital-panel-blackhole-owner-decision-2026-10-25.json: the unresolved lifetime panel-attempt flag at Sync

confirmed_rules.rule: The Hospital panel allows one code attempt per player for the entire match. Once used, that opportunity is spent globally, whether the submitted code is correct or incorrect.
Blackhole branching and Sync do not reset or duplicate the patient's attempt allowance. An attempt remains spent even if the reality in which it occurred is not selected.

The global attempt flag is distinct from healing inventory. Healing requests/effects and reserved/spent injections still follow the selected reality under BH-PANEL-01 through BH-PANEL-05; discarding a reality can discard its healing request and injection cost without restoring the patient's attempt.

An incorrect code consumes the patient's attempt but no injection. An accepted correct-code request reserves an available injection in the relevant reality and, if retained at Sync, follows the same round's Rescue stage. Sync does not create an immediate heal.

owner_confirmation.question: If a patient tries the code but their reality is not selected, should their one lifetime opportunity remain spent because they have already seen the result of their guess?
owner_confirmation.language_note: English translation of the owner discussion.

remaining_integration_work: The broader pre-vote Blackhole Sync and normal end-round resolution integration remains separate. This decision does not move the agreed Rescue stage.
implementation_boundary: Design reference only. Existing historical records, engine behavior, active matches and deployed gameplay tuples remain unchanged.
